name: Engraved sci-fi poster
description: Fine contour-line illustration on black: layered cloud bands, a beam of light or a sun disc, tiny monoliths.
light: one vertical beam or a sun disc on the horizon, lines catching orange, red and teal
composition: portrait format, horizon in the lower third, symmetric beam or disc, big black sky
camera_or_medium: engraving-like vector linework, every form built from parallel contour lines
texture_detail: thin even lines, no gradients, no photographic texture
subjects: a vertical beam of light rising from a sea of contour clouds
a sun disc over layered red dunes
a tiny monolith under a ringed eclipse
